title: Pullman's garden lodge and lawn now match the 1890s pictures
items: Across 18th Street at 1800 Calumet, the gardener's lodge no longer shows a tall east wall above the glasshouse range. As in the 1894 plate and Lowe's photograph, its upper storey now steps back behind the bowed corner.
A gravel drive now turns east off the conservatory drive and crosses the far side of the lawn toward Calumet Avenue, the pale line both pictures show.
